Question:

SQL:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        m.interest_name,
        MAX(im.composition) as max_composition,
        im.month_year
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map m ON im.interest_id = m.id
    GROUP BY im.interest_id, m.interest_name, im.month_year
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_name,
        max_composition,
        month_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition DESC) as rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition ASC) as rn_asc
    FROM max_composition
)
SELECT month_year AS time, interest_name, max_composition
FROM ranked_categories
WHERE rn_desc <= 10 OR rn_asc <= 10
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN rn_desc <= 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    max_composition DESC

WITH max_composition AS (
  SELECT im.interest_id, 
         im.month_year, 
         im.composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) as rn
  FROM interest_metrics im
  WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_categories AS (
  SELECT imi.interest_name, mc.month_year, mc.composition
  FROM max_composition mc
  JOIN interest_map imi ON mc.interest_id = imi.id
  WHERE mc.rn = 1
),
top_10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_categories ORDER BY composition DESC LIMIT 10
),
bottom_10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_categories ORDER BY composition ASC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM top_10
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM bottom_10

),
max_per_category AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_name,
        MAX(max_composition) as highest_composition,
        month_year
    FROM max_per_interest
    GROUP BY interest_name, month_year
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT

        highest_composition,
        month_year as time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_composition DESC) as rank_desc,

),
top_10 AS (
    SELECT interest_name, highest_composition, time

    WHERE rank_desc <= 10
    ORDER BY highest_composition DESC
),
bottom_10 AS (
    SELECT interest_name, highest_composition, time
    FROM ranked_categories
    WHERE rank_asc <= 10
    ORDER BY highest_composition ASC
